contact_measurement.finger_proxies: 128 actual-triangle distal flexion-side patch samples per assigned finger
contact_measurement.surface_sampling: clipped eligible source triangles, deterministic stratified area sampling
contact_measurement.candidate: any same assigned distal patch point within inward finite fret cell, lateral3mm and signed plane height[-1,3]mm, facing cosine>=0.1, with distal body load
contact_measurement.evidence: GPU net rigid body contact force and live source-mesh surface geometry
contact_measurement.limitations: no body pair, contact witness, calibrated string force, pressure, vibration or sound; finite sampling can miss surface contacts
contact_measurement.compatibility: new measurement; original pair-feature clean success is not inherited

wrong_press.effective: selected target geometry: own loaded facing distal pad at an unauthorized string/fret, or another finger at a higher fret on the target string; penalties only on audible overlap
wrong_press.own: positive assigned pad takes precedence over incidental own samples; any simultaneous active selected own target cell is authorized
wrong_press.other: full thumb/finger2/3 loaded virtual-string samples; same/lower fret is not wrong; higher blocks even with positive assigned pad
wrong_press.pad_geometry: finite unique nearest press-plane string within3mm, signed height[-1,3]mm, facing cosine>=0.1, distal netload>=0.01N, fret interior inset2mm
wrong_press.times: raw geometry at both physics endpoints, integrated over clipped audible overlap; no time-mask before trapezoid; overlapping sources do not multiply penalty
wrong_press.confidence: only unambiguous fret interiors contribute; no inferred wrong from unloaded/absent contact
wrong_press.source_fret_range: inclusive min/max contributing source fret per target/body; read only where source time>0
wrong_press.next_preparation: matches future scoped own finger/string/fret in press-2..onset; diagnostic only, never exempts current interference
wrong_press.scope: GPU left finger-skill only; net body force cannot identify contact partner, calibrated pressure or sound

song.scope: new loaded-body geometric candidates; not original pair-feature clean or acoustic success

scope.range_samples: prepared reset t0 plus every completed60Hz control endpoint; not240Hz extrema
scope.tracking_error: command target minus actual q at completed60Hz endpoints; excludes t0
scope.action_samples: one applied action per completed control tick; first action has no change pair
scope.action_sign_flip: opposite nonzero signs in adjacent actions; zero transitions are not flips
scope.action_sign: output sign only; velocity direction for incremental, prepared-reference side for position
scope.limit_outward: incremental only: action points outward at preceding target bound within1e-6rad; position reports0 because bounded desired angles cannot request beyond native bounds
scope.native_limit_fraction: actual and commanded angles separately within1e-6rad of native bounds at completed60Hz endpoints; not240Hz extrema or contact force
scope.scope: diagnostic only; command target is not immediate physical motion, pressure or sound

contract.duration: completed physics endpoint count/240; thumb completed control endpoint count/60
contract.exclusions: overlapping per-finger seconds; never sum exclusions as disjoint time
contract.standby_masks: actual v5 score-only per-finger active union; release0.05s and0.1s fade; next preparation0.35s and0.1s fade; direct/partial/full gap recovery; finite geometry required
contract.idle_angles: gate-weighted valid geometric flexion; denominator per joint valid gate-weighted seconds
contract.press_angles: own assigned press..end inclusive, valid geometric flexion; denominator per joint valid seconds
contract.standby: actual inverse-quadratic helper per_finger_rate integrated at240Hz; weighted reward excludes entire failed control tick exactly as environment
contract.initial_quality_decline: quality below reset reference minus1e-6; completed240Hz fullgate==1 samples before own first press-2; absent fingers whole song; invalid reset/current angles excluded; no sample means evaluableFalse
contract.recovery: fixed own-note-union gaps: previous end+0.05s release+1.0s provisional return budget through next press-0.35s; initial start1.05s, final end song duration; windows>=0.5s evaluated at80% planned occupancy; no policy gate in denominator; not a proven return-time guarantee
contract.gate_runs: actual gate>0 and gate==1 completed240Hz endpoint runs; lengths/counts/band occupancy include ongoing runs; thresholds0.5/1/3s; no dynamic per-tick trace
contract.wrist: absolute nearest-box delta by live guitar-local Gx/Gy/Gz; inclusive inside region; physics endpoint samples
contract.thumb: minimum Euclidean distance from existing finite source thumb2/3 support vertices to face-referenced playing-neck1 rear facets (outward normal Gz < -0.5); excludes unused OBJ vertices and headstock transition; rear-side compatible permits signed plane gap >= -1 mm
contract.thumb_limitation: legacy60Hz support vertices have no normals; shared thumb_support240Hz uses same-point patch position/normal and selected-point signed gap; neither certifies native contact pairs, pressure, sound, full mesh penetration or cooked collision geometry
contract.thumb_support: shared helper rate at240Hz:0.01/s geometric quality plus0.01/s same-point quality times binary contact candidate; actual weighted payout uses completed-control failure suppression, approach weight and explicit multiplier0(off)/1(on); native net force and rear-normal load are resultant proxies, never pressure or contact-pair certification
contract.thumb_contact_candidate: shared selected point signed gap[-0.001,0.0005]m, finite central neck-rear region, facing>=0.1, native thumb3 rear-normal load>=0.01N; force magnitude above threshold gives no further reward
contract.thumb_normal_load: helper relu(native thumb3 resultant in guitar coordinates dot unit rear normal); mean denominator is helper normal_load_valid completed physics seconds
contract.thumb_nearbutunloaded: near_geometry and normal_load_valid with rear-normal load<0.01N; excludes invalid loads and does not imply a known body pair
contract.extreme_combinations: 240Hz geometric flags per finger: MCP<-20deg and PIP/DIP>60deg; MCP/PIP>75deg and DIP<10deg; DIP-PIP>50deg. Flags overlap and are diagnostics only; idle means outside own press..end, independent of B gate

source_recovery.scope: Original score windows intersected with actual phrase playback; initial preparation excluded. Unobserved time after failure remains in planned denominators.

motion.scope: Current control endpoint phase; mean of same128 material-point vector norms, invalid samples contribute zero with fixed128 denominator. Paths are not additive and do not measure force shares or causal success percentages.

wrist_termination.sample_scope: final240Hz sample at episode60Hz boundary; not a trajectory maximum
wrist_termination.target_index_scope: indices in compiled source score; candidates do not certify sound or pair pressure
